title: [ingest] defusedxml is not a core Sphinx dependency; lazily imported in etree_parse
summary: `defusedxml` is imported inside `sphinx.testing.util.etree_parse()` rather than at module top-level. It is a test-only dependency (listed in test extras). Code that imports `sphinx.testing.fixtures` or `sphinx.testing.util` in production will NOT pull in defusedxml unless etree_parse is actually called.
